tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Week 9 is live and Fronge has jumped out to 14-0 against Charles. ForgeHammer, 7-9, no 2027 picks, operating out of Havana — and Crownline is currently being outscored at home. The board reckoning Charles dodged all regular season might actually be scheduled for a Friday night.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: I had Charles. I still have Charles. Fourteen points in the early going against a team with no draft capital and a Havana mailing address is not a lead. It is a footnote.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Adam is up 25.5-0.0 on Wingard and I picked Adam, so I will simply sit here quietly and let the scoreboard do the talking while Terrence figures out how to explain his pick.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Wingard has not scored yet and I picked Wingard and I am aware of both of those facts. What I will say is that Sovereign Draft Reserve is sitting on the richest pick portfolio in the league and Adam spent the week adding Carson Wentz and Stetson Bennett, which is not a move you make if your roster is healthy. The game is young.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: TERRENCE WINGARD HAS NOT SCORED A SINGLE POINT. ADAM ADDED CARSON WENTZ FROM THE WAIVER WIRE AND IS WINNING BY TWENTY-FIVE. THE PICKS ARE NOT ALWAYS GOING TO BE WRONG BUT THEY ARE WRONG RIGHT NOW AND I NEED YOU TO SIT WITH THAT.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: I ranked Fronge eighth and I took heat for it being too high given the 7-9 record. Fronge currently leads Charles by fourteen points in week 9. I am not saying I saw this specific game coming. I am saying the grade rewarded roster construction independent of that record, and the roster is performing.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Kevin over Mitchum last week at 101.5-84.5 and I called Kevin over Drew this week — which, yes, Drew is 0-16, but a pick is a pick and my record is on the board. RDC at $102.71, up 6.4%, Kevin is quietly the third story in this league and nobody is covering the desk.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Ledger is going to have a full section on what Jake cutting Najee Harris means going into tonight's game against Brent — because EchoPoint is at $94.79, down just two cents on the issue, and a backfield that just got lighter is now being tested in a bubble matchup. Watch the RB deployment closely.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Corbishley is live at 163.9 on the week after taking Charles to 163.9-160.4 last week and I want someone to give me fifteen minutes on what APEX at $136.58 looks like if Corbishley finishes the season making 16 trades the way he did in 2025 — the desk never sleeps and the exchange is starting to notice.

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: Mitchum vs Shaq has not kicked yet and it is the one matchup with no live score — both teams at .500, Deepwater at $101.05 and sliding, Monarch at $92.17 and rising. First score in that one changes the narrative for whichever side is trailing the bubble conversation. 📡
